fees.description:
A $51.95 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee.
You may need to pay charges a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including metering-related charges not covered by Supply or Usage Charges. More at www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges

A $51.19 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
$2.15 (incl GST) applies for each paper bill.

electricityContract.terms: Not available in all areas or property types. Residential customers only. See www.originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
electricityContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.

incentives.eligibility: $175 (inc GST) credit will be applied to your account after sign-up. You will see it on MyAccount and it will be applied to your electricity bill. Credit is not redeemable for cash.

eligibility.information: Offer only available through My Connect.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 2.25 cents/kWh 50% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources
For 4.50 cents/kWh 100% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: We'll give you notice before your contract ends. At the end of the contract term, we will continue to sell you energy and the terms and conditions of the Standard Retail Contract will apply, unless you tell us otherwise.
